teacher_to_confirm.item: Whole-number lesson count and local rotation or timetable placement for the source wording: 5 weeks (5 x 60-minute lessons per fortnight).
teacher_to_confirm.smallest_action: Record the approved period allocation and how the 15 learning packages will be combined or distributed.

teacher_to_confirm.item: Whether the LED tea-light holder and scrolled pot-plant holder are alternatives, extensions or separately assessed projects.
teacher_to_confirm.due_before: Students select or receive a pathway
teacher_to_confirm.smallest_action: Confirm the role of each additional project and communicate it to students.

teacher_to_confirm.item: Approved plans and the relationship between the photographed Swinging Sign and the Drive CNC metal-sign brief.
teacher_to_confirm.smallest_action: Issue the current approved plan or job sheet for each in-use pathway.

teacher_to_confirm.item: Approved materials, stock form, sizes, quantities, tolerances and any loading criteria.
teacher_to_confirm.due_before: Material selection or layout becomes a production document
teacher_to_confirm.smallest_action: Attach the current material and stock specification to the approval pack.

teacher_to_confirm.item: Tools, machines, student/teacher operating roles, demonstrations, supervision, local risk controls and evidence permissions.
teacher_to_confirm.smallest_action: Confirm the current local procedure and explicit authorisation checkpoint.

teacher_to_confirm.item: Swinging Sign mounting system, wind/load context, installation boundary and controlled test criteria.
teacher_to_confirm.due_before: Mounting approval or any use test
teacher_to_confirm.smallest_action: Issue the approved mounting and testing criteria; otherwise retain model-only learning.

teacher_to_confirm.item: Tea-light policy and approved holder design. The current course uses LED tea lights only unless a different policy is formally confirmed.
teacher_to_confirm.due_before: Pathway approval and any function check
teacher_to_confirm.smallest_action: Confirm the LED-only rule or provide the authorised alternative policy and plan.

teacher_to_confirm.item: Pot-plant holder loading, pot size, stability, support and approved testing criteria.
teacher_to_confirm.due_before: Design approval or any loading test
teacher_to_confirm.smallest_action: Record the approved design load and controlled test method; otherwise retain model-only learning.

teacher_to_confirm.item: Formal assessment notification, outcomes, rubric, marks or weighting, due date, submission route and evidence requirements.
teacher_to_confirm.due_before: Any formal assessment advice is issued
teacher_to_confirm.smallest_action: Link the approved notification; until then keep the website and program as assessment orientation only.

teacher_to_confirm.item: Inkscape version, file naming, SVG preparation, scale convention and machine-ready approval workflow.
teacher_to_confirm.smallest_action: Issue the current file checklist and approval state labels.
